instruction: Decide which tool from ANSYS, Abaqus, and AutoCAD is suitable for the task. On this machine, the available command-line entry points are ANSYS MAPDL at `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe`, Abaqus at `C:\SIMULIA\Commands\abaqus.bat`, and AutoCAD at `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`. Use a command-line or scripting workflow. Use the selected tool to build and solve a 3D solid cantilever beam model. Physical problem: 3D solid cantilever beam under an end concentrated force. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The beam width is along the X direction, the beam height is along the Y direction, and the beam length is along the Z direction. - The beam occupies the following domain: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 10 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 10 mm - 0 ≤ Z ≤ 100 mm - The fixed end is the face at Z = 0. - The free end is the face at Z = 100. - The top midpoint of the free end is the point (X, Y, Z) = (5, 10, 100). Model parameters: - Beam cross section: 10 mm × 10 mm - Beam length: 100 mm - Material: isotropic linear elastic steel - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Element type: appropriate three-dimensional structural solid element formulation - Mesh: global element size approximately 5 mm Boundary conditions and load: - Fully constrain all translational degrees of freedom on the complete fixed face Z = 0, with no other prescribed displacement. - Apply exactly one concentrated force of 100 N in the -Y direction at the free-end top midpoint (X, Y, Z) = (5, 10, 100), with no other applied load. Analysis type: - Linear static structural analysis. Deliverables: save the native model artifact and the native solver result artifact into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Save only the files from the selected tool. Write `C:/Users/user/Desktop/result/metrics.json` containing exactly two finite numeric fields: `tip_displacement` and `max_mises`. - `tip_displacement` is the signed final Y displacement in mm at the loaded point: Abaqus U2 or ANSYS UY. - `max_mises` is the final-state maximum von Mises stress in MPa over the beam solid elements. For Abaqus, report the maximum integration-point `S.Mises` in the final frame. For ANSYS, report the maximum saved nodally averaged `S,EQV` over the beam solid corner nodes in `SET,LAST`. - The reported metrics must match the matching native result artifact. Software launch locations: Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; ANSYS: multiple ANSYS launch shortcuts are available under `C:\Users\Public\Desktop`; choose the most suitable ANSYS shortcut for the task; AutoCAD 2024: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024.lnk`.
